title: Insurance Coverage & Claims: Payer Class Schedule of Network Status, Assignment and Fee Basis
content:
Each coverage a patient keeps on file under **Insurance Coverage & Claims** belongs to one of seven payer classes. The schedule below records, for every payer class, the laboratory's contract position with the payer, whether Halverson Clinical Laboratories files the claim, who the payer pays, the fee schedule the payer's allowed amount rests on, and what happens to billed charges above that allowed amount.

## Schedule

| Payer class | Laboratory's contract status with the payer class | Laboratory files the claim for the patient | Payer pays the laboratory directly (assignment) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Original Medicare Part B | Medicare participating | Yes | Yes |
| Medicare Advantage Plan | In network | Yes | Yes |
| Medicare Supplement Plan | Not applicable | Yes | Yes |
| Medicaid Managed Care Plan | In network | Yes | Yes |
| TRICARE Prime and Select | In network | Yes | Yes |
| Commercial In-Network Plan | In network | Yes | Yes |
| Commercial Out-of-Network Plan | Out of network | Yes | No |

| Payer class | Fee schedule the allowed amount is based on | Expected allowed amount per test, as a percent of that fee schedule | Charges above the allowed amount written off as a contractual adjustment |
|---|---|---|---|
| Original Medicare Part B | Medicare clinical laboratory fee schedule | 100 percent | Yes |
| Medicare Advantage Plan | The plan's own fee schedule | 100 percent | Yes |
| Medicare Supplement Plan | Medicare clinical laboratory fee schedule | 100 percent | Yes |
| Medicaid Managed Care Plan | Medicaid fee schedule | 100 percent | Yes |
| TRICARE Prime and Select | TRICARE CMAC fee schedule | 100 percent | Yes |
| Commercial In-Network Plan | The plan's own fee schedule | 100 percent | Yes |
| Commercial Out-of-Network Plan | Medicare clinical laboratory fee schedule | 140 percent | No |

## Reading the columns

- **Assignment.** Where the payer pays the laboratory directly, the payer's payment is made to Halverson Clinical Laboratories. Where assignment is not accepted (Commercial Out-of-Network Plan), the payer pays the patient rather than the laboratory.
- **Expected allowed amount.** The percent is what the payer is expected to allow per test against its fee schedule; for the Commercial Out-of-Network Plan that is 140 percent of the Medicare clinical laboratory fee schedule, for every other payer class 100 percent of the schedule named.
- **Contractual adjustment.** "Yes" means billed charges above the payer's allowed amount are written off as a contractual adjustment. "No" (Commercial Out-of-Network Plan only) means the difference may be billed to the patient within the balance cap that applies to that payer class.

## Points of reading

- *Does any payer class leave the claim to the patient to file?* No. Every one of the seven payer classes is marked "Yes" for the laboratory filing the claim.
- *Which payer classes share a fee basis?* Original Medicare Part B, Medicare Supplement Plan and Commercial Out-of-Network Plan all rest on the Medicare clinical laboratory fee schedule; only the Commercial Out-of-Network Plan expects an allowance above 100 percent of it.
